title: About SRM IST Tiruchirappalli | Vision, Mission & Heritage
text:
ABOUT SRM INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY, TIRUCHIRAPPALLI
Vision: To emerge as a world-class university imparting knowledge, creating innovations, and instilling human values to serve society globally.
Mission: To provide holistic education fostering technical competence, research spirit, ethical leadership, and societal responsibility.

FOUNDER & HERITAGE:
SRM was founded by Dr. T. R. Paarivendhar, visionary educationist, philanthropist, and Member of Parliament. From a humble beginning, SRM has blossomed into India's premier multi-disciplinary education conglomerate. The Tiruchirappalli campus was established to bring world-class technical, healthcare, and management education to the central region of Tamil Nadu.

ACCREDITATIONS & RECOGNITIONS:
• NAAC A++ Accreditated: SRM Institute of Science and Technology, (formerly SRM University) has been recently accredited with the highest grade A++ (3.58/4.0) by NAAC (National Assessment and Accreditation Council) for 16.08.2018 – 15.08.2023. It is another feather on SRMIST’s cap as it prides over being awarded the highest ranking given to institutions. In the new accreditation process, about 70% weightage is assigned to quantitative metrics.
• University Grants Commission: SRMIST has been placed under Category I University by UGC / Ministry of Education as per the UNIVERSITY GRANTS COMMISSION [CATEGORIZATION OF UNIVERSITIES (ONLY) FOR GRANT OF GRADED AUTONOMY] REGULATIONS, 2018 
By becoming Category I University with 12 B Status, SRMIST is in elite group of 2 Central Universities, 12 State Universities and 11 Deemed to be Universities in India. In Tamil Nadu, only three Universities, including SRMIST, have been granted this rare distinction.
• IET Accreditation: Following programs of Kattankulathur Campus are accredited by The Institution of Engineering and Technology (IET) – Till 2022. Visit https://www.theiet.org/ for more information. 


B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering | B.Tech Software Engineering | B.Tech Electronics and Instrumentation Engineering | B.Tech Automobile Engineering
• Engineering Accreditation Commission of ABET: Following programs of Kattankulathur Campus are accredited by the Engineering Accreditation Commission of

ABET, http://www.abet.org. – Till 30.09.2023

B.Tech Civil Engineering | B.Tech Mechanical Engineering | B.Tech Electrical and Electronics Engineering | B.Tech Electronics and Communication Engineering
• Computing Accreditation Commission of ABET: Following program of Kattankulathur Campus is accredited by the Computing Accreditation Commission of ABET,  http://www.abet.org – Till 30.09.2023

B.Tech Information Technology
• ICAR: SRM College of Agricultural Sciences is Accredited by Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR).
• Category 1 University status conferred by University Grants Commission (UGC).
• Approved by AICTE, PCI, INC, NCAHP, and Government of India.
